pageDescription: Suggest your ideas, see the ones that are kept and support the ones you like.
ideaPlaceholder: For example: a cooking stream on Sundays
nickHelp: Shown with your idea. No need for your real name.
hintReview: Your idea is reviewed before it shows on this page.
hintOpen: Your idea shows on this page right away.
none: No idea yet. Send the first one with the field above.
searchPlaceholder: A word from the idea or its status
truncated: Only the first {n} ideas are shown. Use the search or change the sort.
noteSent: Thank you, your idea is published on this page.
noteReview: Thank you, your idea is received. It will show after review.
noteLimit: You have already taken part a lot. Try again in an hour.
noteInvalid: Write your idea in a few words, for example: a cooking stream.
noteLong: Your idea is too long. Keep it to {max} characters.
noteLinks: Keep one link at most in your idea.
noteFull: The idea box is full for now. Try again later.
noteDup: This idea is already in the list. You can support it.
noteVoted: Thank you, your support is counted.
noteProblem: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
adminIntro: Review the ideas you receive, publish them and make them move forward.
pendingBanner: {n} ideas are waiting for your review.
pendingBanner_one: 1 idea is waiting for your review.
tableEmpty: No idea yet. They show up here as soon as someone sends one on the page {path}.

confirmDelete: Delete this idea and all its supports? This cannot be undone.
editPublished: This idea is published: everyone sees it on your page.
editPending: This idea is waiting for review. Turn on “Published” to show it on your page.
editRefused: This idea is refused. Turn on “Published” to put it back on the page.
editHidden: This idea is off the page. Turn on “Published” to show it again.
replyExample: Thanks, we are thinking about it
mergeText: This idea goes away and its supports are added to the idea you keep.
mergeNone: There is no other idea to merge with.
mergeConfirmText: The idea to merge goes away. Its supports are added to the idea you keep.
backToList: Back to the list of ideas
err_notFound: This idea no longer exists. Reload the page.
err_state: This action is not possible for this idea.
err_status: Choose a status from the list, for example Planned.
err_replyLong: Write 280 characters at most, for example: Thanks, we are thinking about it.
err_textEmpty: Write the idea in a few words, for example: a cooking stream on Sundays.
err_textLong: Keep it to {max} characters, for example one or two sentences.
err_nickLong: Keep it to 30 characters, for example: Moon_92.
err_target: This idea is refused. Choose another one to keep.
